mapper.select: SELECT id AS tenantId, slug, name, lifecycle_state AS lifecycleState, plan, effective_policy_version AS effectivePolicyVersion, tenant_authz_version AS tenantAuthzVersion, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM platform.tenant WHERE status = #{statusFilter} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT agent_limit AS agentLimit, run_concurrency_limit AS runConcurrencyLimit, budget_limit AS budgetLimit FROM platform.tenant_quota WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid

INSERT INTO platform.tenant (slug, name, plan, status, lifecycle_state) VALUES (#{slug}, #{name}, #{plan}, 'PENDING_SETUP', 'PENDING_SETUP') RETURNING id AS tenantId, slug, name, lifecycle_state AS lifecycleState, plan, effective_policy_version AS effectivePolicyVersion, tenant_authz_version AS tenantAuthzVersion, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.tenant SET lifecycle_state = #{toState}, status = #{toStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND lifecycle_state = #{fromState}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform.tenant_quota (tenant_id, agent_limit, run_concurrency_limit, budget_limit) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{agentLimit}, #{runConcurrencyLimit}, #{budgetLimit})
INSERT INTO platform.tenant_capability_grant (tenant_id, resource_code, scope, status, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{resourceCode}, #{scope}, 'ACTIVE', 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE platform.tenant_capability_grant SET status = 'REVOKED', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND resource_code = #{resourceCode}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenantId, resource_code AS resourceCode, scope, status, version FROM platform.tenant_capability_grant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
